articles.title: NVIDIA Joins NSF State and Regional AI Hubs Program to Expand AI Research and Education Across the US
articles.body_text: NVIDIA is participating in the U.S. National Science Foundation’s (NSF) State and Regional Artificial Intelligence Infrastructure Hubs program, an effort launching today to expand access to the advanced computing, data, software and expertise needed for AI-enabled research and education.
